scenes.prompt: Divine darshan of Bhagwan Vishnu with four arms holding conch, chakra, mace and lotus, blue complexion, golden crown and yellow silk dhoti, serene face, standing on a pink lotus, a soft golden halo, tulsi leaves and lit clay diyas in the foreground, a decorated temple sanctum

scenes.sub: Guruvar Vishnu ji! Bhagwan Shri Hari ki kripa aap par sada bani rahe.

scenes.prompt: Shirdi Sai Baba seated calmly on a stone with one leg folded, white kafni robe and white head cloth, a gentle blessing hand, an old Dwarkamai mosque wall behind, warm lamp light
scenes.animate: a very slow push-in, the lamp light glows softly, the face stays still
scenes.tts: श्रद्धा और सबूरी, जीवन को आसान बना देती है।
scenes.sub: Shraddha aur saburi, jeevan ko aasaan bana deti hai.

scenes.prompt: A green tulsi plant in a decorated clay pot on a temple courtyard at dawn, lit diyas around it, yellow marigold flowers and a small brass kalash, calm golden light
scenes.tts: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। स्टेटस पर लगाएं, और सबको भेजें।
